$description: Site-wide structure: origin, locales and the rules that generate breadcrumbs, internal links and keywords. Routes are in routes.json and areas.json; dsapkit checks all of it with make site.

root.$description: A fixed redirect, never by IP or browser language (Google: avoid automatic language redirects). Google takes the site name from the redirect target, so the WebSite markup lives on /en/.

breadcrumbs.$description: Home > Pillar > Page at most. Only pillars appear as the middle crumb.

linking.$description: Links every page gets, generated from data so no page is forgotten.

keywordPlanner.$description: Files for Google Keyword Planner, written by make site into packages/site/dist/keyword-planner. Seeds feed 'Discover new keywords' (Google allows 10); the search-volume lists feed 'Get search volume and forecasts'. Google Ads keywords may have up to 80 characters and 10 words.

commute.$description: Area pages state how long the trip to the centre takes for a student arriving by the batch start (the arriveBy field of fact batch.timings). An area page publishes only once D-SAP confirms its commute.

commuteSources.osm: OpenStreetMap: area centre from Nominatim, driving route from OSRM to each centre's confirmed pin (head office from D-SAP's Maps link, Wakad from its plus code), on empty roads; times at 3 PM are longer. Fetched 2026-10-31; the pinned routes are in packages/map/source/routes.json.
commuteSources.web-wakad-aundh: distancebetween2.com and Rome2Rio, Wakad to Aundh, 2026-10-31: about 8.6 km, 12 to 16 minutes.
commuteSources.web-wakad-new-sangvi: distancesfrom.com, Wakad to New Sangvi bus stop, 2026-10-31: about 6 km.

contactLinks.$description: How the site turns facts into links. {e164} is the phone fact as +digits, {digits} without the plus; {latitude} and {longitude} come from a centre's geo fact. Directions open Google Maps; the site embeds no map.

$centreGates: Keys of a centre's facts that must be confirmed before its page goes live (NAP must be complete to match Google Business Profile).

centreKeywords.$description: Centre pages are found by people looking for D-SAP at a place; the area page next to it targets the area search. {name} is the centre's area.

areaKeywords.$description: Keyword patterns for area pages. {name} is the area's name in that language. Hindi and Marathi patterns are drafts until native keyword research (plan Phase 4).
